summary.answer: Tests existence of CoD[key] and its new field; returns true/false without constructing the widget. Specialist milestones require statname prefix transmission; global milestones require specialist_transmissions or hero_transmissions. Other cases return false. Returns true only for milestone_group and the requested include column equal to weapon_knife. Checks eight named weapons with gold/diamond suffixes, then weapons_mastery excluding knife_loadout or secondary_mastery excluding weapon_knife. The recovered f84_local3 assignment has no local declaration here; do not silently change its scope. Reads milestone/tier/target/unlock/category/XP/vial fields, scans rising tier IDs, then chooses title/subtitle per milestone type. Builds reticle/camo/unveil/ZM medal and calling-card metadata with the exact guards, plus XP/vial display entries, and returns a presentation table. Zombies mastery camo may return nil under its dvar. Nested f88 mastery/expert helper runs only at its shown call. Preserve block-local leakage in ZM medal/reward-size branches and empty arms; no reward grant, repaired fallback or service implementation is inferred.
